description: DAWNSTAR GLOBAL SURPLUS: Mining town abundance. Ores (Iron/Quicksilver) and basic weaponry are cheap.
DAWNSTAR GLOBAL DEFICIT: Frozen wasteland. Survival goods (Food, Wood, Warmth) are critical imports.
QUICKSILVER RUSH: Home to the Quicksilver mine. Massive local supply drives prices into the ground.
IRON BREAKER: Iron Breaker mine floods the market with raw iron and cheap tools.
SALT TRADE: Port city surplus. Salt is used for curing and is abundant.
THE FROZEN HEARTH: Critical demand for fuel and warmth. Firewood is life.
GREEN DEFICIT: Permafrost prevents farming. Fresh vegetables cost a fortune.
